scope: Bounded development on previously used calibration images only. Test0825-0836 and all other HR images are not read. Frozen existing LTE/SC checkpoints; no SR training. New LR-only diagnostic inspired by classical cross-scale internal recurrence, not a new mechanism or theorem. Calibration images lie in original DIV2K training split; exact per-checkpoint inclusion is not re-audited. OOF independence is selector fitting only, not unseen-network image generalization.
hypotheses: H1: At a fixed model, upscaling factor and frequency band, the signed native-versus-zero-cell gain in a lower-resolution self-reconstruction task predicts the corresponding target-task gain across images.
H2: Adding only this lower-task signed gain to the existing magnitude/spectrum ridge improves held-image-out harmful-gain detection and RGB policy over all simple controls.

Counterexample: lower-task native gain may be positive while true task gain is negative because second downsampling removes informative texture or changes aliasing. Retain all such cases; do not add texture thresholds after results.

data.original_target: stored HR128 centre crops; original truth scoring reused after features freeze
data.original_observation: saved bicubic-AA LR y,64 or32; no repeated original HR inference
data.lower_input: F.interpolate(y, size=(128/s/s), bicubic, antialias=True, align_corners=False), clamp0to1
data.lower_target: the observed y itself,64 or32; no unknown HR enters lower-task gain
data.lower_queries: midpoint n*n grid, model coordinate2q-1; nativecell2/n vs zero
data.evaluation_region: same spatial fraction as HR shave4: lower target shave4/s (2 or1); lower scored side60 or30 vs original120
data.bands: fullRGB includes DC; three raw RGB Chebyshev FFT bands [0,1/8),[1/8,1/4),[1/4,.5001), exclude DC. Same scale, same cycles/output-pixel boundaries; different discrete supports disclosed
data.normalization: Zlow=max(mean((croppedy-channelmean)^2),1e-8); Zupper inherited observable bicubic variance; t=lowergain/Zlow
data.predictions: raw RGB, no output clipping, no augmentation, one lower level, preserve all cases

features_and_controls.zero_shot_candidate: internal_transfer=t*Zupper; predicts harmful iff forecast<0; RGB native iff forecast>0
features_and_controls.augmented_candidate: internal_ridge = inherited12dim norm features plus t, standardized on other folds; target gain/Zupper; ridge lambda1 intercept unpenalized
features_and_controls.folds: 8 fixed image groups, fold=(image_id-1)%8; hold all scales/bands of four images out jointly; model-specific fits on remaining28 images; mean/std and band median recomputed training folds only
features_and_controls.selection: no hyperparameter, feature, threshold, crop, band or scale search; both candidates and models reported separately; no best-result selection

primary_evaluation.class: per model pooled32images*2scales*3bands; negative>=12rows spanning>=6images; recall>=.75 precision>=.6 FPR<=.25; BA exceeds every baseline by>=.05 and paired image-cluster 95% lower>0
primary_evaluation.within_cell: report every model*scale*band cell, negatives/positives/ties, sign table; macro pairwise harm-AUC over cells with both signs. At least3 of6 eligible cells and candidate-vs-norm AUC improvement>=.05 and paired-image95% lower>0 required. This prevents between-band or between-scale sorting from carrying the claim. Ties in forecast contribute .5; no actual ties in AUC.
primary_evaluation.RGB_policy: native if predictedgain>0 else zero,32images*2scales; paired-image95% lower MSE improvement>0 versus EVERY control; also PSNR/regret and harmful/beneficial switch counts
primary_evaluation.promotion_gate: classification AND within-cell AUC AND RGB policy for the same candidate/model. This is only a DEVELOPMENT go/no-go; independent new cohort needs another frozen protocol. If none passes, do not infer an effective selector or start matching training.
primary_evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 image-cluster resamples seed20261012; all scales/bands of image resampled jointly. Model-specific OOF fits NOT retrained in each bootstrap, intervals conditional on fixed OOF forecasts, overlapping fits and in-training images disclosed; no global/generalization coverage claim.
primary_evaluation.bootstrap_missing: Freeze eligible model/scale/band cells from complete development cohort; use same cells in every resample. AUC draw missing either class in any eligible cell is undefined and excluded as a whole, not silently averaged over fewer cells; report valid/missing draws. BA missing a class likewise undefined. Require>=1000 valid of2000 draws for a CI-based promotion; else inconclusive.
primary_evaluation.forecast_zero: forecast<0 flags harmful; forecast==0 flags not harmful for classification but chooses zero-cell for RGB policy. Actual abs(gain)<=1e-8 retained, excluded from sign/AUC denominators only.
primary_evaluation.AUC_score: raw signed predicted gain, identical scoring convention for every method; lower predicted gain indicates greater harm.

freeze.before_inference: source+protocol+64observations+128originalprediction+calibration_rows+oldcheckpoint/source hashes recorded; original target labels loaded only after all lower features/predictions frozen. Copy input bytes to new root read-only snapshot; old dirs untouched
freeze.before_scoring: all512lower outcome features and128lower prediction NPZ hashes; OOF score labels come from previously used calibration_rows, retrospective development not newly blinded confirmation
freeze.audit: Independent pixel/FFT feature, folds/no-leak fit, all metrics/gates/bootstrap/cost/hash checks; inference/model reimplementation scope separate

budget.resume: absolute deadline fixed at launch, never reset; errors/missing retained; source changes need new version/root

related_sources.claim: ZSSR uses internal recurrence and lower-resolution examples to train per-image CNN; this trial uses frozen model pair to forecast intervention gain, no CNN adaptation. Internal recurrence principle not novel.
Glasner/Bagon/Irani2009 established within/across-scale patch recurrence for SR; recurrence alone does not imply intervention-gain transfer.
